Note.title: Demo meeting
Note.summary_text:
Product Walkthrough
Sam demoed Granola’s core notepad and transcript features
Notepad works like a regular text editor: type notes during the meeting
Transcript visible via green dancing bars at the bottom of the screen
Enhanced Notes
At meeting end, Granola auto-detects and generates enhanced notes
Notes combine transcript capture with anything typed in the notepad
Manual flow: stop button, then “Enhanced Notes” button

Note.summary_markdown:
# Product Walkthrough

- Sam demoed Granola’s core notepad and transcript features
- Notepad works like a regular text editor: type notes during the meeting
- Transcript visible via green dancing bars at the bottom of the screen

# Enhanced Notes

- At meeting end, Granola auto-detects and generates enhanced notes
- Notes combine transcript capture with anything typed in the notepad
- Manual flow: stop button, then “Enhanced Notes” button
